name: Bar Break
summary: A split payment where the bill is a chocolate bar and a snap line shares it between two methods
about: A checkout step for paying one order with two methods. The PKR 8,400 bill is a bar of twelve squares: the dark part goes on one method and the milk part on the other, and the jagged snap line can be dragged, moved with the keys or set by typing either amount. Limits are real, so a gift card stops at its balance with a springy bump, and paying snaps the bar in two, charges each part with its own ring and wraps it in gold foil.
how: Drag the snap line, or focus the bar and use the arrow keys (Page Up and Page Down move a whole square)
Or type an amount in either box: the other part and the bar follow
Pick a method for each part; picking the same one on both sides swaps them
A gift card cannot pay more than its PKR 2,000 balance: the line bumps and stops at the limit
Press Pay: the bar snaps in two, each part charges in turn, then gold foil wraps it as PAID
